structured.approach: I read both contracted inputs: feat.tasks for the Backend tasks TSK-05 and TSK-06, and feat.design for the scope boundaries, DD-1, NF-10, A8 and B3. Both say storage, databases and schema migrations are out of scope. I then checked the ap_aging checkout. I opened CLAUDE.md, src/ap_aging/aging.py and src/ap_aging/__init__.py with Read to confirm there is no database client or storage code. The repo-access tool view also says there is no database. The output cites only files I opened with Read in this session, the two inputs, the brief and the tool view. The step was small, so I did not delegate to a subagent and did not use any connector.

claims.text: Storage, database and schema migration are outside this design; the data in scope is held in memory only.
DD-1 adds no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage. Only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS are used.
Every new function is pure and in-memory, with no I/O and no network (NF-10).
The Backend tasks TSK-05 and TSK-06 change only src/ap_aging/aging.py, src/ap_aging/__init__.py and tests/test_overdue.py, and neither lists a database dependency.
TSK-06 adds no transport layer, because a transport would re-trigger DES-01.
ap_aging has no database; no migrations exist or are required.
ap_aging is Python 3.9 using the standard library, with code in src/ap_aging/ and tests in tests/.
aging.py imports only datetime.date, decimal.Decimal and typing.
The package __init__.py imports only aging_buckets from .aging, and the package version is 1.4.0.
Any storage or network call from the libraries would reopen the platform design (DES-01).

open_questions: Non-blocking, carried: DQ-1 asks which production component wires the stages and carries CT-1. If that becomes a transport or adds persistence, BE-03 must run again.
structured.summary: BE-03 for FEAT-ZD-48600: TSK-05 and TSK-06 in ap_aging need no database change, so nothing is left to complete. The design rules out storage and migrations, the new functions are pure and in-memory, and the repository code I read has no database client. No DBA or infra action is needed, and BE-04 can start. task.db_changes.md has been rewritten in full, and it lists what would require running BE-03 again.
